NEET protest FIR names man claiming to be in Russia

A NEET exam paper leak protest in Bihar has led to an FIR naming Mohammad Sadakat, a resident of Kishanganj. Sadakat claims he is falsely implicated, stating he has been in Russia for the past four months. He has communicated this claim to the Bihar Police.
